name: task-handoff
description: Independently verify an AI agent's work in a local git repo and get a compact, evidence-labelled handoff.
long_description: Task Handoff inspects what actually changed in a local git repository, runs only the checks relevant to those changes (syntax, lint, typecheck, targeted tests, build, Playwright when configured), cross-checks the agent's claims, and returns a short report where every statement is labelled VERIFIED, CLAIMED, INFERRED, NOT TESTED or BLOCKED. It never installs packages, never commits, pushes, resets or deletes. Note: verification runs the project's own tests and build scripts. Requires git and Python 3.9+ on PATH; macOS and Linux.

tools.name: start_task
tools.description: Record a baseline before work starts so pre-existing edits are not attributed to the task.

tools.name: inspect_task_state
tools.description: Read-only: attributed changes, impact categories, risk flags, and the checks that would run.

tools.name: run_relevant_checks
tools.description: Run the cheapest meaningful checks for the changed files.

tools.name: verify_task
tools.description: Full verification with claim cross-checking; returns the handoff and a next prompt.

tools.name: summarize_handoff
tools.description: Return the last report without re-running checks (flags it if stale).

tools.name: find_repos
tools.description: Find git repositories on this computer so you can refer to projects by name.

tools.name: check_setup
tools.description: Diagnose missing tools or test dependencies and get exact fixes.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed directories
allowed_directories.description: Optional. Only repositories inside these folders can be inspected or verified. Leave empty to allow any local repository.
